race.comment: AGENT ZERO (2) has a solid record at this distance range and was unsuited by the race tempo, which developed into a sprint home from the 600m when fourth over 1850m at Newcastle in BM88 class. Looks to get the right tempo today and has solid prospects. BOTANICAL BOY (5) knocked up late when a month between runs to run fourth over 1800m at this track. Has the further improvement to play a leading role. KOOLIBAH (9) has strengthened over the break and looks ready for this tougher test with the 2kg weight drop. Defeated inferior opposition in the small field over 1900m at Canterbury in BM72 class. Has genuine each way claims. VALOROUS POWER (3) created a big impression with the 60.5kg when scoring over the 1550m at Canterbury. Sticky draw today and look for him late.
